sources.finding: September 17 club reporting names Austin Barber as the Week 2 right guard. This supports primary-role identity, not an extra performance-based rating change.

The final Week 2 inactive list includes Teven Jenkins, Parker Brailsford, Toriano Pride Jr., Daniel Thomas, Justin Jefferson and emergency third quarterback Taylen Green. An inactive list alone is not a complete injury-strength total.

Sampson was placed on injured reserve on September 15, before this game; McLaughlin joined the active roster. Sampson is absent from the pinned Week 2 currentCases and must be added to historical coverage. The transaction alone does not define lost-role allocation.

The team identifies Sanders as an option behind Judkins after Sampson went to IR and discusses his added kick-return work. Offensive and return roles require reconciliation; no workload or impairment percentage is inferred.

Game-day reporting lists Parrish inactive and Morrison as his expected starting replacement. McMillan and Killebrew are active. This is a reported-primary case input, not proof of complete team coverage.

September 16 club reporting describes Morrison taking over Parrish's lineup role after Parrish was injured in the preceding game. This is pre-Week-2 role continuity context, not a Week 2 final gamebook.

These observations do not authorize an in-game impairment fraction or complete QB no-loss conclusion.

Retained reserve-list inventory: Sampson, Kalia Davis, Royer, Gabriel, Alex Wright, Mathis, Kendrick Green and Owusu-Koramoah. September releases remove Thrash and Bell; waived injured players have no established Week 2 assignment.

Retained reserve-list inventory includes Hayes and Sills, with McKnight placed on IR before roster cuts; waived-injured Kamara, Pepe Williams and Xavier Williams are distinct from active game-day absences.

Sanders inherits Sampson kick-return duties and supports Judkins in the backfield. McLaughlin also activated; model retains both available reserves rather than treating Judkins existing role as new replacement credit.

Retrospective Week 2 participation: Trotter returned after third-quarter shoulder injury, 48 defensive snaps. Dennis is listed relief ILB; Rozeboom played no defense. Morrison started for Parrish. Only retrospective Week 2 facts and role hierarchy are used, not new-week injury forecasts.
Parrish inactive. McMillan and Killebrew active. Other Tampa scratches: Capehart, Garnes, Haggard, Schrauth, Simmons. Cleveland list confirms Jenkins and five reserve/emergency scratches.
Final Cleveland 23 Tampa Bay 19. Watson and Mayfield quarterbacked through the decisive fourth-quarter possessions; no injury-related QB replacement is reported.

Undrafted rookie McKnight first appeared in preseason, suffered hamstring injury, and was removed from 91-man camp roster onto IR August 25. No established regular-season assignment; exclusion is an explicit roster-role modelling assessment, not a zero player valuation.
